lesson.title: Preserve documentation and answer authorities
lesson.summary: Preserve provider documentation and supply necessary authority evidence.

prerequisites.reason: Technical documentation is one retained record

blocks: **Documentation custody** under Article 18 keeps specified provider records at authorities’ disposal for a period ending ten years after market placement or service. These include technical and quality-system documentation and the EU declaration.

Include approved changes and decisions/documents from notified bodies where applicable. A notified body is an authorised assessment body for the relevant procedure. Do not invent a certificate for a procedure that requires none.

Ten-year documentation custody differs from controlled-log retention, whose separate qualified rule is taught elsewhere. Financial institutions within the specified financial-law governance rules keep technical documentation as part of the relevant financial documentation.
Record which evidence belongs to which rule, its relevant start event, retrieval location and responsible actor. A six-month document deletion policy would not meet the ten-year documentation rule.

**Authority cooperation** follows a reasoned competent-authority request. Supply all information and documentation needed to demonstrate system-requirement conformity in an easily understood Union official language indicated by the Member State.

Give applicable access to automatically generated logs to the extent under the provider’s control. Information received by authorities is subject to Article 78 confidentiality. A private trade-secret assertion does not itself cancel the cooperation duty.

**Documentation continuity** remains a concern if a provider or its representative becomes bankrupt or ceases activity before the period ends. Each Member State determines conditions for keeping the specified documentation available.

Case: Northbridge plans to close and delete its records. Check the relevant Member State arrangements and implement continuity. Do not assume the duty simply vanishes, or invent a national handover procedure without a source.
